text: Cognition is an applied AI lab building end-to-end software agents; its headquarters are in San Francisco and it has raised over $400m from Founders Fund, Lux Capital, 8VC, Bain Capital Ventures, and other leading investors.
short: Cognition is a San Francisco-based venture-backed AI lab (makers of Devin).
